correctness.rationale: The spatial norming functional on finite real/complex ℓ_p reduces to aligned nonnegative phases. y_i=|x_i|^(p/2), sum y_i²=1, t=1−2/p gives F_t=Σa_i y_i^(1+t)y_(i+1)^(1−t). At t=0 its strictly simple Perron maximizer h has a strictly negative tangent Hessian: the envelope theorem legitimately gives G=1/2 Σ a_i h_i h_(i+1) log(h_i/h_(i+1)). In n=3, h=(a/r,1,c/r)/sqrt(2), r=sqrt(a²+c²), yields the correctly signed u-log expression. For n=4, (r²−a²)(r²−c²)=b²r² and the explicit Perron vector give the reported small-b and large-b logarithmic leading terms; the O(b²) and O(1/b) remainders do not erase them. The duality v_p(T_reverse)=v_q(T) where 1/p+1/q=1 makes the reversal-in-p assertion local and strict. No claim of threshold uniqueness or all-p monotonicity is made.
residual_risks: Finite numeric slopes corroborate signs only; do not establish all b or limits.
Positivity of weights and 1<p<∞ are essential for the interior Perron branch.
